lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance circular spots arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial region, extending horizontally along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of blobs to form a characteristic checkerboard anchor node pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and shadowing on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible lateral surface of the first dorsal fin contains a low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily concentrated towards the posterior margin.
